description: Expected bytes derived by hand from the rule text at rc.5 (RC5-A); the reference engine does not yet produce them, so this vector is listed in tests/conformance/pending.json until RC5-B. Supersedes bnd-0012, correcting two defects. (Q55d) site.base is now stated in input, so every href in the expectation is derivable from the vector alone instead of assuming a default. (V9A-10) the webmcp agsc-surface-version is no longer a pinned constant: AGSC-11-16 as amended at rc.5 conforms ANY YYYY-MM-DD Draft Community Group Report date, because the report is a living document — it read 2026-09-15 when bnd-0012 was written and 17 September 2026 on 2026-09-19. The vector therefore states the date the node targets in input, asserts that the declaration ECHOES it, and asserts its SHAPE; a node targeting any other date passes unchanged. Everything else is bnd-0012's case: every served surface declared with its id, external version and access class derived from what is emitted, the built-in access classes fixed (llms-txt and chunks none, webmcp and mcp consent), the three WebMCP annotation hints per tool (AGSC-11-18) and the MCP extension identifier advertised in the extensions map of the capabilities reported under revision 2026-07-28 (AGSC-11-18 as corrected at rc.5, V9A-04 — that revision has no initialization handshake). The expectation member mcp_extensions names the extension IDENTIFIERS the node advertises, which is the key set of the extensions MAP that AGSC-11-18 defines; the per-identifier settings object is pinned by AGSC-11-18 and asserted whole by bnd-0035 and by bnd-0036, so this vector states no capability shape of its own (added at rc.5, RC5B-02).
